improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Meet Gideon: a Claude-powered assistant built for business owners, traders, and professionals. Instant AI answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access. Start with three free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://yourdomain.com/og-gideon-preview.jpg">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://yourdomain.com/">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
improvements.rationale: A well-crafted meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating value and the free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the price anchor and key features (voice chat, instant answers) differentiates Gideon in search snippets.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This copy clearly introduces the product name and its core function, immediately communicates the key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support), and includes a specific, low-friction CTA that highlights the free trial without overpromising. The structure moves from brand introduction to benefits to action, which aligns with conversion best practices.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to join GDN AI as a member. Membership starts from just US$2 per day and unlocks unlimited access to Gideon, including voice chat, your personal members workspace, and full trade and business support. Choose monthly billing or save 30 percent with an annual plan.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most likely friction point for new visitors—understanding what comes after the free trial. It transparently explains the paywall, reinforces value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace), and highlights the annual savings incentive, reducing hesitation and encouraging conversion.
